styleLock.direction: quiet premium mobile-storage furniture ecommerce, editorial rather than cozy-lifestyle
styleLock.backgroundSystem: real interior surfaces kept uncluttered: matte plaster wall, pale oak plank floor, one ink-slate graphic field for infographic screens; a single clean text zone per screen, never busy decor
styleLock.lightingSystem: one hard directional side key at 4300K from a declared single side, crisp long cast shadow plus soft bounce fill on the shadow side, raking light along shelf edges and frame joints, visible contact shadow under feet or wheels; never flat shadowless studio
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte-finished frame members and shelf faces rendered exactly as the reference material, edges caught by raking light; wheel and hardware surfaces shown at low grazing angle; no gloss repaint
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline 28-34pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt; generous left or top margin reserved for copy, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.5px monoline thin-line pictograms only, #F2EEE8 strokes on the ink-slate field and #2F4B57 strokes on the off-white field, simple geometric shapes, maximum four per screen, no filled illustration, no 3D badges
styleLock.presentationRules: the unit keeps identical proportions, tier count and footprint in every frame; standing on the floor with visible contact shadow, never floating; verticals kept straight; real furniture used as scale anchor; hero 3/4 angle reused across scene screens so the product reads as one object
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or contradictory shadow directions
no invented dimensions, materials, grades or certificates
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium mobile-storage furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper off-white #F2EEE8, deep ink-slate #2F4B57, pale oak #C8BCAD and one amber accent #C29A5B; neutral tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; background system of real interior surfaces (matte plaster wall, pale oak plank floor) plus one ink-slate graphic field, each screen keeping a single clean text zone; lighting system of one hard directional side key at 4300K with a crisp long cast shadow, soft bounce fill on the shadow side, raking light along shelf edges and frame joints, and a visible contact shadow under the feet or wheels; surface system that renders the reference material and finish exactly as supplied, matte, edge-lit; layout system of generous left or top copy margin, 1px leader lines, numbered circles and at most four thin-line icons; icon system of 1.5px monoline pictograms in #F2EEE8 on ink-slate and #2F4B57 on off-white; product presentation rules: identical proportions, tier count and footprint in every frame, standing on the floor with contact shadow, straight verticals, real furniture as scale anchor, reused 3/4 hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cozy soft-focus tint, no invented dimensions, grades or certificates.
